short: An unbriefed vice president who inherited the bomb and the Cold War in one afternoon.
full:
Truman had been vice president for 82 days and knew nothing of the atomic programme when Roosevelt died. Within four months he had attended the Potsdam conference, ordered the use of the bomb against Japan, and accepted a Japanese surrender.

The rest of his presidency built the machinery of the Cold War: the Truman Doctrine of 1947 pledging support to Greece and Turkey, the Marshall Plan, the National Security Act creating the CIA and a unified defence department, the Berlin airlift of 1948 and 1949, and NATO in 1949. He desegregated the armed forces by executive order in 1948 and won that year's election against every prediction and most published polls. He committed American forces to Korea in June 1950 without a declaration of war, and relieved Douglas MacArthur of command in April 1951 for insubordination, at severe political cost.
